_instructions: Quick-Entry: paste event objects into the 'quickEntry' array. They are merged at build time and take precedence over scraped data (dedup by title+date). Required fields: title, eventDate, city. All others optional. Dates must be YYYY-MM-DD. Known venue keys for automatic lat/lng: 'Hard Rock Hotel Daytona Beach', 'The Shores Resort & Spa', 'Daytona International Speedway', 'Ocean Center', 'Peabody Auditorium'.

quickEntry._note_root_cause: These 3 events use non-Eventbrite URLs (welcometorockville.com, jeepbeach.com, daytonainternationalspeedway.com). sheet-import.js requires an Eventbrite URL matching /eventbrite\.com\/e\/[^/?#]+-\d{5,}/ — any other URL is silently skipped at line 163. These events will never import via the sheet unless their Eventbrite listing URLs are added to column A.
quickEntry._note: placeholder — remove this object before adding real events
